old_text: Choose tau in G_(K T_j) whose cocycle value is outside that image. If the chosen lift of g already has nonzero cocycle value modulo (g−1)A, keep it; otherwise replace it by tau times that lift.
new_text: Choose tau in G_(K T_j) whose cocycle value is outside that image. Since K is cut out by the adjoint representation, r(tau) is a scalar, not necessarily the identity. Let e be its order in k^*, which is odd. Replace tau by tau^e. This remains in G_(K T_j), its residual matrix is now the identity, and its cocycle value is unchanged: tau acts trivially on A, so c(tau^e)=e c(tau)=c(tau) in characteristic 2. If the chosen lift of g already has nonzero cocycle value modulo (g−1)A, keep it; otherwise replace it by this adjusted tau times that lift.
